tasks.label: Generate Comprehensive Benchmark Analysis
tasks.command:
.venv/Scripts/python.exe -c "import pandas as pd; import numpy as np; df = pd.read_csv('Source/Benchmarks/benchmark_results_full.csv'); print('
' + '='*120); print('📊 FUTOSHIKI BENCHMARK COMPREHENSIVE ANALYSIS'); print('='*120); print(f'
✅ Total Test Cases: {len(df)} across {df["Size"].nunique()} grid sizes'); print(f'
🔍 Grid Size Distribution:'); sizes = df['Size'].value_counts().sort_index(); [print(f'   {size}: {count} cases') for size, count in sizes.items()]; alg_cols = [c for c in df.columns if '(s)' in c]; print(f'
🎯 Total Algorithms Tested: {len(alg_cols)}'); for col in alg_cols: print(f'   • {col.replace(" (s)", "")}'); print('
' + '='*120); print('⚡ ALGORITHM PERFORMANCE RANKING (By Success Rate)'); print('='*120); perf = {}; [perf.update({col.replace(" (s)", ""): len(pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce').dropna())}) for col in alg_cols]; sorted_algs = sorted(perf.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True); print(f'{"Algorithm":<25} {"Success Rate":>20} {"Avg Time (s)":>20} {"Avg Memory (MB)":>15}'); print('-'*120); [print(f'{name:<25} {count}/10 ({count*10}%) {"":>13} {np.mean([x for x in pd.to_numeric(df[name+" (s)"], errors='coerce').dropna() if x != "Timeout"]):.4f}s {"":>12} {np.mean([x for x in pd.to_numeric(df[name+" (MB)"], errors='coerce').dropna() if x != "N/A"]):.2f}MB') for name, count in sorted_algs]; print('
' + '='*120)" 2>&1
